SELECT s.id, s.location_id, l.name AS location_name, s.description, s.shot_at, s.status, s.review_reason, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission_asset count_asset WHERE count_asset.submission_id = s.id ) AS asset_count, ( SELECT cover_asset.object_key FROM submission_asset cover_asset WHERE cover_asset.submission_id = s.id ORDER BY cover_asset.sort_order, cover_asset.id LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_key, s.submitted_at, s.updated_at FROM submission s LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = s.location_id
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
